note: The AI here is two Gemini parsers (voice transcript and receipt file). They only pre-fill the transaction form, and the user presses save, so there is a human review step and no AI tool writes data. No mock data and no fake success handlers found in app code. Skipped: components/ui (shadcn), docs/, .claude/, .codex/, .ecc/, .agents/, tests/, generated public/sw.js. No .env file is committed, only .env.example with empty values. The main risk is in the database: the transaksi balance trigger runs as SECURITY DEFINER, and migration 011 moved only the hutang triggers to SECURITY INVOKER.

labels.what: transaksi insert and update policies check only user_id. rekening_id and rekening_tujuan can point to another user's account. The balance trigger update_saldo_rekening is SECURITY DEFINER with no fixed search_path, and no later migration replaces it, so it bypasses RLS and changes the other user's saldo_saat_ini

createTransaksi (and updateTransaksi at 139-217) checks only that rekening_id, rekening_tujuan and kategori_id are UUIDs. It never checks that they belong to the caller, so with the definer trigger a user who knows another account id can move that account's balance

processVoiceInput calls the paid Gemini parser with no getUser check. The sibling processTransactionFile does check. voice-parser.ts also starts with 'use server', which makes parseVoiceTranscript its own server action with no auth
Voice parsing calls Gemini on every request with no rate limit or per-user quota. Only a 1200 character input cap exists
File auto-fill sends up to 4 MB images or PDFs to Gemini per call with no rate limit or per-user quota

User transcript is placed inside quotes in the prompt with no escaping and no instruction to ignore embedded commands. The file prompt has such a rule, the voice prompt does not. The JSON schema and sanitizer limit the effect to the user's own form
Prompt says judul is at most 50 characters. Code caps it at 200, and the transaction schema also allows 200
Prompt says catatan is at most 200 characters. Code caps it at 500
Prompt forbids copying account, card or phone numbers into judul or catatan. The sanitizer only trims length and has no redaction, so a model slip saves full account numbers
Defense against instructions hidden in uploaded files exists only as a prompt line. The structured schema and sanitizer bound the output

changePassword treats currentPassword as optional and has no length check on newPassword. The form requires both, but a direct server action call with a live session can set a new password without the old one
Session revoke is checked only when the device_id cookie is present. A client that drops that cookie skips the check, and revokeSession never revokes the Supabase refresh token
Users can UPDATE any column of their own session rows, including revoked_at, so a holder of a revoked session can clear revoked_at through the Supabase API
The typed DELETE confirmation is checked only in the browser. deleteAccount deletes the auth user with the service role on any authenticated call, with no re-authentication
safeNextPath rejects // but accepts /\host, which the URL parser turns into another origin. This allows an open redirect after a successful code exchange
Avatar upload trusts the client file.type and file-name extension. image/svg+xml passes and is stored in a public bucket

Balance corrections are read-modify-write in app code with no transaction or lock. createTransaksi also accepts tipe correction with client-chosen correction_add or correction_sub tags, and deleting such a row then shifts the balance
Offline queue in IndexedDB keeps financial payloads that are not tied to a user and not cleared at sign out. The next user on the same device replays them under their own session
avatars bucket is public and the read-all SELECT policy on storage.objects lets anyone list objects, which exposes every user id used as a folder name

Service role key is read in the shared environment module that the browser Supabase client imports. Next.js does not inline non NEXT_PUBLIC values, so no value ships today, but the boundary is fragile
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY is browser exposed by design. Value is empty in the example
App URL falls back to http://localhost:3000 with no production guard
App URL falls back to http://localhost:3000 with no production guard
localhost:3000 default for the app URL outside production
Gemini timeout is 20000 ms here and 25000 ms in the file parser. The same setting is hardcoded with two values
